findings.title: Validator on subject can reject inbound candidate emails containing {{placeholder}} patterns
findings.evidence: Agent 8: validates :subject, custom_channel_message: true applies to all sent_by types including sent_by_candidate. If a candidate's reply subject contains {{word}}, the message silently fails to save.
findings.consolidation_note: Agent classified as HIGH. Consolidated as MED because: (1) spec explicitly says to apply validator 'the same way it is currently applied to body', (2) pre-existing body validator has same issue without production problems, (3) scenario requires {{word}} in email subject which is extremely unlikely, (4) implementation correctly follows spec. Valid design concern for future hardening.

findings.title: HTML sanitizer encodes ampersands in plain-text subjects
findings.evidence: Agent 5: sanitize() converts & to & in subject. User types 'R&D Department', recipient sees 'R&D Department'. Root cause: spec says to use same Sanitizer#sanitize as body (HTML sanitizer) but subject is plain text.
findings.recommendation: Future: use a plain-text sanitizer for subject that strips control chars but doesn't HTML-encode.

findings.title: HTML sanitizer strips angle-bracket content from subjects
findings.evidence: Agent 5: 'RE: <Please Read> Your Application' becomes 'RE:  Your Application'. Sanitizer treats angle-bracket content as HTML tags. Same root cause as L2-009.

findings.title: ChannelMessageTemplatesController does not sanitize template subjects
findings.evidence: Agent 1: template controller permits :subject but never calls sanitize(). Body is also not sanitized at template level (consistent), but XSS payloads persist in template subject. Currently not exploitable (React auto-escapes JSX text). Stored XSS time-bomb if dangerouslySetInnerHTML is ever used.

findings.title: blank? before scrub ordering can crash on malformed UTF-8 (pre-existing, upgraded from LOW)
findings.evidence: Agent 14 validated L2-001: text.blank? raises ArgumentError on malformed UTF-8 before text.scrub can clean it. Caught by outer rescue handlers so no crash, but prevents message delivery. Pre-existing (affects body too).

findings.title: BulkChannelMessageSendJob rescue block does not check :subject errors (runtime confirmed)
findings.evidence: Agent 12 confirmed C-006 from Layer 1 at runtime. Subject validation failure silently swallowed, user gets no growl notification.

findings.title: No length validation on subject column (varchar)
findings.evidence: Agent 2: 500-char subject stores without error. Frontend likely constrains, but no server-side guard.

findings.title: No newline/CRLF stripping in subject at any layer
findings.evidence: Agents 5, 8: Subjects with \r\n pass validation and reach Mailgun. Mailgun likely handles it, but no defense-in-depth.

findings.title: Sanitize::Config::RELAXED preserves HTML tags in subjects
findings.evidence: Agents 1, 2: Tags like <b>, <i>, <a> survive sanitization. Render as literal angle-bracket text in email Subject header.

prior_findings_validation.L2-001: VALIDATED by Agent 14, upgraded LOW -> MED (see L2-012)
prior_findings_validation.L2-INFO-001: VALIDATED by Agent 14, downgraded to INFO (infrastructure concern, not feature bug)
prior_findings_validation.C-006: CONFIRMED at runtime by Agent 12 (see L2-006-CONFIRMED)

convergence.note: Agent 8 classified inbound validator issue as HIGH; consolidated as MED (spec-compliant, pre-existing pattern, extremely unlikely scenario). 0 HIGH+ after consolidation.
